comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Code.require_file / Code.eval_file with dynamic paths.' We already detect Code.eval_string but miss Code.eval_file/1-2 and Code.require_file/1-2. These load and execute Elixir code from a file path — if the path is tainted, an attacker can trigger arbitrary code execution by pointing to a malicious file. Add to @code_exec_sinks in the extractor. Severity: Critical.

title: Elixir: detect Code.eval_file and Code.require_file with dynamic paths
